fr.recommendations:
• Install a reflective address marker at the driveway entrance so responders can confirm the correct property from the road.
• Mark the single driveway entrance clearly on both sides to help responders locate access without delay.
• Clear a turnaround area near the main residence or detached structure large enough for an emergency vehicle to reverse direction without backing onto the access drive.
• Trim vegetation along both sides of the access drive to maintain a clear path wide enough for emergency vehicles to pass without obstruction.
• Cut back dense vegetation growing close to the main residence and detached structure so responders can move around both buildings on foot.
• Keep the walkway between the main residence and detached structure clear so responders can move between the two buildings quickly.
• Thin dense vegetation between the main residence and detached structure so responders have a visible, passable route connecting the two buildings.
• Keep the patio area clear of stored items so it can serve as a staging area for responders working near the main residence.
• Mark any gate or pathway that provides access to the rear of the property so responders do not have to search for entry points under the dense vegetation.

wildfire.recommendations:
• Trim back tree branches and shrubs that are directly touching or overhanging the house on all sides.
• Thin the tree clusters near the structure to create open gaps between individual trees and between the trees and the house.
• Remove low-hanging branches from large trees near the house, cutting them up to at least 10 feet from the ground.
• Clear woody debris, including fallen branches, bark, and wood piles, from the area immediately surrounding the structure.
• Mow or cut the grass cover around the structure and keep it short, especially during dry periods.
• Thin scattered trees across the property to reduce the amount of connected vegetation leading toward the house.
• Keep the open clearing free of encroaching shrubs and woody growth to maintain separation between vegetation and the structure.
• Trim overhanging branches along the full length of the driveway so vehicles, including emergency equipment, can pass through without obstruction.
• Keep the driveway surface clear of fallen branches, debris, and overgrown vegetation on the edges that could narrow the travel lane.
• Mark the driveway entrance clearly so it is easy to locate from the road, particularly if vegetation along the road obscures the opening.
• Remove or relocate any wood piles, brush piles, or debris stored near the house or any outbuildings to a location well away from structures.
